# Gauswarn India - Pure A2 Gir Cow Ghee

> Gauswarn India is a trusted brand offering 100% pure, traditional bilona-made A2 Gir Cow Ghee, sourced from grass-fed indigenous Gir cows and prepared using Ayurvedic methods.
